name.description: A new display name, 1 to 60 characters; surrounding spaces are removed.

inherits.description: The role's parents from now on. It replaces the whole list; `[]` removes every parent. A list that would lead back to this role is refused with `role_cycle`.

items.patternErrorMessage: A role key is lower-case: it starts with a letter and continues with letters, digits and underscores, up to 63 characters in all — `operate`, `night_shift`. A capital, a dash, a dot, a space or a leading digit is refused, and `defaults` is reserved.

key.description: A new key. On its own, the rename is accepted at once and everything that still names the old key turns into a warning. To rewrite those places as well, add `update_references`.
key.patternErrorMessage: A role key is lower-case: it starts with a letter and continues with letters, digits and underscores, up to 63 characters in all — `operate`, `night_shift`. A capital, a dash, a dot, a space or a leading digit is refused, and `defaults` is reserved.

update_references.description: With `key`: rewrite every place that names the old key to the new one, in one transaction. Without `confirm`, when there are places to rewrite the call changes nothing and answers `409 confirmation_required` with the preview; a rename with none applies at once and needs no token.

confirm.description: The `confirm` token of the preview the caller was shown. It confirms that preview only; if the places to rewrite have changed since, the call answers a new preview.
